sourceDescription: A user-approved AI-generated monochrome illustration developed from the user-supplied Dune_Tarot_Hilary_Clarcq.webp drawing. The supplied filename identifies Hilary Clarcq; authorship and publication were not independently verified.

approval.scope: The user approved the monochrome bitmap and explicitly discarded every multicolor proposal. Only the monochrome design is included.

/vector/decal/tarot-deck.svg.trace: Potrace 1.16, turdsize 8, alphamax 1.0, opttolerance 0.25, followed by authoring provenance, uniform square normalization and the decal optimization profile.
/vector/decal/tarot-deck.svg.paint: Inherited from the caller. Card layers, radial motif, disk, flap seams and tassel strands use transparent cutouts.
